newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures firmer in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures firmer in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were a tad firmer in the after-hours session on Monday, lifted by short-covering reflecting the yen's weakness against the dollar, traders said.
Prices ranged from unchanged to 0.9 yen per kg higher than the day's close. Benchmark March was 0.2 yen firmer at 134.5.
Activity was lacklustre with only 7,647 lots traded.

During the day, prices ended lower after shedding early gains as investors were quick to take advantage of any price rally to sell. "The market's direction hinges on the currency market and technical factors," one trader said.
